title: Normal Forms for First-Order Logic — Prenex Normal Form
subtopics: Definition of equivalence in structure S
Prenex normal form: all quantifiers at the front
Algorithm for converting a FOL formula to PNF

definitions.term: equivalent formulae in a structure S
definitions.definition: φ₁ and φ₂ are equivalent in S (φ₁ ≡ˢ φ₂) if for every S-assignment α, S,α ⊨ φ₁ iff S,α ⊨ φ₂.
φ₁ and φ₂ are equivalent (φ₁ ≡ φ₂) if they are equivalent in every structure S.
A formula of the form Q₁x₁. Q₂x₂. … Qₙxₙ. ψ where each Qᵢ ∈ {∀, ∃} and ψ is quantifier-free.

algorithms: PNF conversion: push quantifiers outward using equivalences, rename variables to avoid capture
learning_objectives: Define equivalence of FOL formulae in a structure and globally.
Rename bound variables to avoid capture (α-renaming).
Convert a FOL formula to prenex normal form.
